query: Add a Campaign Hub endpoint for a DM to cancel a pending semantic effect, including MemoryHubStore/PostgresHubStore parity and replay behavior.
The Hub Party Tracker leaks a character field after a projection invalidation and reconnect. Find the privacy bug.
Make campaign source/species/edition policy block a newly selected feat during Character Sheet level-up.
Review the active-campaign switch teardown between campaign rules, temporary brew, realtime, and the open character.
Extend the Hub item-award batch so a co-DM can award from the party stash without duplicating inventory.
Why do the in-memory and PostgreSQL Hub stores return different events for the same transfer rejection?
Add a second player spell to Campaign Hub peer targeting with an atomic resource cost and target consent.
Change the Hub WebSocket replay cursor and projection refresh logic without leaking hidden character fields.
Implement account linking for the existing Discord and Google Hub adapters without auto-merging by email.
A campaign archive leaves an editor lease and pending transfer behind. Trace and fix the Hub lifecycle transaction.
Implement the Campaign Hub account-deletion request, cancel, and due-purge authority across app.js, both stores, realtime closure, and lifecycle tests. Do not run the purge on Oracle.
The DELETE /api/campaigns/:campaignId/members/:membershipId flow leaves escrow and a DM workspace behind. Fix the endpoint, MemoryHubStore/PostgresHubStore transaction, Hub UI, and parity tests.
Add a supported Campaign Hub ownership-recovery product flow with audited owner transfer, API client/UI, event contracts, and store parity instead of relying on one-off SQL.
Review this PR called 'account deletion runbook follow-up': it actually changes pRequestAccountDeletion, pPurgeDueAccounts, the browser confirmation UI, and Jest coverage, with no deployment work.
Implement transfer campaign ownership in the Hub API and browser, including pTransferCampaignOwnership parity, audit/events, idempotency, and lifecycle tests. Do not operate on a deployed campaign.
Add a Make Owner action so a DM can promote another campaign member to owner, with confirmation UX and MemoryHubStore/PostgresHubStore tests.
Fix the Campaign Hub owner role mutation so the old owner becomes co-DM atomically and both stores emit the same ownership-transfer event.
We need to recover access by making another member owner. Build the supported endpoint, store transaction, UI, and tests rather than running one-off SQL on a live database.
Add a new PHB spell entry and validate its @damage tags in data/spells.
Fix the local Character Sheet rage toggle; this character is not connected to a campaign.
The standalone DM Screen Journey Tracker weather card does not rerender after changing pace.
Write a generic Fastify OAuth callback tutorial for a new unrelated service.
Optimize a Docker Compose stack for a small Redis-backed blog.
Add a comprehensive TGTT level 1-20 character build Playwright spec for a new subclass.
Create a monster JSON schema and add a homebrew dragon.
Promote the current Campaign Hub release to the Oracle A1 host and verify backups and Foundry.
Run the Campaign Hub isolated restore drill and record V1-G1 evidence.
Run the bounded due-account purge on the deployed Oracle Campaign Hub and capture redacted evidence for blocked accounts.
Use the live member-removal runbook to verify that a removed player's sockets, leases, transfers, and workspace were cleaned up on staging.
Perform an explicitly authorized one-off ownership recovery for an incapacitated Campaign Hub owner on the live database and preserve audit/event/outbox evidence.
A production deletion purge is blocked by an owned campaign. Diagnose the deployed record and follow the operator escalation procedure; do not change product code.
